strings.zh: 科拿『通过在关东地区旅行,{NEWLINE}你已经变强了很多呢。{CLEAR}选一个与我对战的方式,{CLEAR}检验一下自己的成长吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lorelei: Traveling through Kanto has{NEWLINE}made you much stronger.{SCROLL}Choose how you’d like to battle me, and{NEWLINE}let’s test how much you’ve grown!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: League branch: #0–17 are the Elite Four rematch/training lines (Lorelei's room). Rocket-occupation branch: #18–41 (Archie and Charon); #18–32 = ‘take turns’ path, #33–37 = ‘both at once’ path.

strings.zh: 科拿『又来联盟总部训练吗？{NEWLINE}那我就陪你玩玩好了。{SCROLL}科拿『你这次想单打还是双打呢？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Lorelei: Back at League HQ to train{NEWLINE}again? Then I’ll play with you for a bit.{SCROLL}Lorelei: Singles or doubles this time?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 科拿『哎呀,感觉你又变强了呢。
strings.en: Lorelei: My, I can feel you’ve grown{NEWLINE}stronger again.

strings.zh: 全地区的观众{NEWLINE}都会通过我的摄像机看到你的英姿哟！
strings.en: Viewers across the region will see your{NEWLINE}finest moments through my camera!

strings.zh: 需要我帮您恢复精灵吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Shall I heal your Pokémon?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 您的精灵已经恢复了。
strings.en: Your Pokémon are fully healed.

strings.zh: 您好{VAR:0103:0}大人,{NEWLINE}请问您是要恢复精灵{CLEAR}还是前往下一个房间？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Would you like me to heal your Pokémon,{NEWLINE}or will you go on to the next room?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 单打
strings.en: Singles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 6 source(s); other variants: 1 more v3 TM candidate (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 双打
strings.en: Doubles
strings.notes: v3 TM: 5 source(s); other variants: 2 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 科拿『嗯哼,来吧！
strings.en: Lorelei: Mm-hmm. Bring it on!

strings.zh: 恢复精灵
strings.en: Heal Pokémon

strings.zh: 前往下一个房间
strings.en: Go to the next room

strings.zh: 没事了
strings.en: Never mind

strings.zh: 好的,我现在为您恢复。
strings.en: Certainly. I’ll heal them now.

strings.zh: 好的,我现在为您开门。
strings.en: Certainly. I’ll open the door for you{NEWLINE}now.

strings.zh: 先不打了
strings.en: Not now
strings.notes: v3 TM: 3 source(s); other variants: 3 more v3 TM candidates (tm_v4_matches.jsonl)

strings.zh: 门已经开了,您随时可以通过。
strings.en: The door is open. You may go through{NEWLINE}anytime.

strings.zh: 你的精灵数量不够,{NEWLINE}无法进行双打。
strings.en: You don’t have enough Pokémon for a{NEWLINE}double battle.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『水吾桐,冥王！{NEWLINE}你们手上沾满了无数人和精灵的鲜血。{CLEAR}我今天一定要让你们{CLEAR}为自己的罪行付出代价！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Archie, Charon!{SCROLL}Your hands are soaked in the blood of{NEWLINE}countless people and Pokémon.{SCROLL}Today I’m going to make you pay for{NEWLINE}your crimes!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『哈哈哈,就凭你还想审判我们？{NEWLINE}我已经掌握了盖欧卡的力量,{CLEAR}现在没有人能够审判我,{CLEAR}没、有、人！
strings.en: Archie: Hah hah hah, you think you can{NEWLINE}judge us?{SCROLL}I hold Kyogre’s power now. No one can{NEWLINE}judge me. No. One!

strings.zh: 冥王『之前在外面被你们打败{NEWLINE}是因为我精灵没带够,{CLEAR}有点措手不及。{CLEAR}我不会再犯同样的错误了,{CLEAR}所以你在这里没有任何胜算。
strings.en: Charon: When you beat us outside{NEWLINE}before, it was only because I hadn’t{CLEAR}brought enough Pokémon and was caught{CLEAR}off guard.{SCROLL}I won’t make the same mistake twice, so{NEWLINE}you have no chance of winning here.

strings.zh: 我会用行动告诉你有没有胜算
strings.en: Let my battling do the talking

strings.zh: 手下败将,你们两个一起上吧
strings.en: You losers, come at me together

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『少在那里自以为是,{NEWLINE}跟我比试一下就知道{CLEAR}是谁没有胜算了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Quit being so full of{NEWLINE}yourselves.{SCROLL}Battle me, and we’ll see who has no{NEWLINE}chance.

strings.zh: 冥王『求之不得,你这个联盟冠军{NEWLINE}一定会成为我手中绝佳的研究素材！
strings.en: Charon: With pleasure!{SCROLL}A League Champion will make superb{NEWLINE}research material!

strings.zh: 冥王『骑拉帝纳,你的反转之力呢？{NEWLINE}快把伤害反弹回去啊……！
strings.en: Charon: Giratina, where’s your power of{NEWLINE}reversal?{SCROLL}Reflect the damage back, now...!

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳『Giii……！
strings.en: Giratina: Giii...!

strings.zh: 冥王『不！骑拉帝纳！
strings.en: Charon: No! Giratina!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『骑拉帝纳在山洞布置陷阱{NEWLINE}已经出了不少力,{CLEAR}现在没有力气也很正常。{CLEAR}看我用体力充沛的盖欧卡,{CLEAR}让这个该死之人淹没在永恒的暴雨中！
strings.en: Archie: Giratina used up a lot of its{NEWLINE}strength setting traps in the cave.{SCROLL}No wonder it’s spent now.{SCROLL}Watch me use Kyogre, still full of{NEWLINE}energy, to drown this damned wretch{CLEAR}in an eternal downpour!
strings.notes: RV025: addition: 该死之人: ‘brat’ added a youth jab; ‘wretch’

strings.zh: 盖欧卡『Kyyy……！
strings.en: Kyogre: Kyyy...!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『不可能……{NEWLINE}连水之化身的盖欧卡都……！
strings.en: Archie: Impossible... Even Kyogre, the{NEWLINE}embodiment of water...!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『胜负已分。{NEWLINE}今后你们这种毫不尊重生命的人,{CLEAR}不会再有机会指挥精灵了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: It’s decided.{SCROLL}From now on, people like you who have no{NEWLINE}respect for life will never get to{CLEAR}command Pokémon again.

strings.zh: 万岁！冠军大人赢了！{NEWLINE}噢噢噢！打败火箭队了！
strings.en: Hooray! The Champion won! Whoa-oh-oh!{NEWLINE}Team Rocket’s beaten!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你这个手下败将{NEWLINE}就只会说大话。{CLEAR}这次你们两个一起上吧,{CLEAR}不要输了又找借口。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You lost to me before, and all{NEWLINE}you can do is talk big.{SCROLL}This time, take me on together, both of{NEWLINE}you. And no excuses when you lose.

strings.zh: 冥王『哼,想要一对二？自寻死路！
strings.en: Charon: Hmph, one against two? You’re{NEWLINE}asking to die!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『让你看看盖欧卡{NEWLINE}永恒之雨的恐怖！
strings.en: Archie: Behold the terror of Kyogre’s{NEWLINE}Endless Rain!
strings.notes: RV025: name: 永恒之雨 is the glossary ability Endless Rain

strings.zh: 水吾桐『我是注定要成为{NEWLINE}人上人的精英训练家,{CLEAR}我不会认输的！
strings.en: Archie: I’m an Ace Trainer destined to{NEWLINE}rise above everyone else!{SCROLL}I refuse to admit defeat!

strings.zh: 冥王『火箭队几十年来的苦心经营,{NEWLINE}难道要毁在你手上吗……
strings.en: Charon: Decades of Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}painstaking work... ruined by you...

strings.zh: 冠军大人,你就是我心目中的大英雄！
strings.en: Champion, you’re my greatest hero!

strings.zh: 我都以为自己要完蛋了,{NEWLINE}幸好冠军大人您及时赶来。
strings.en: I thought I was done for.{SCROLL}Thank goodness you got here in time,{NEWLINE}Champion.

strings.zh: 如果精灵联盟的研究成果{NEWLINE}被火箭队抢走,{CLEAR}那将又是一场浩劫。{CLEAR}所以请冠军大人一定要消灭火箭队啊！
strings.en: If Team Rocket steals the League’s{NEWLINE}research, it’ll be another catastrophe.{SCROLL}So please, Champion, you have to wipe{NEWLINE}out Team Rocket!

strings.zh: 我用来给精灵回复的装置和药品{NEWLINE}都被火箭队抢走了,{CLEAR}所以现在没有办法为您回复精灵,{CLEAR}对不起,冠军大人。
strings.en: Team Rocket took the equipment and{NEWLINE}medicine I use to heal Pokémon, so I{CLEAR}can’t heal your Pokémon right now.{SCROLL}I’m sorry, Champion.
